clauses.scope_note: Section II grants a nonexclusive, worldwide, nontransferable, nonsublicensable, revocable, royalty-free copyright license to use Baichuan 2 models for noncommercial purposes, subject to Section II restrictions.
clauses.condition_explanation: noncommercial_use follows the defined meaning of commercial use; comply_with_license_restrictions refers to the operative Section II restrictions extracted below.

clauses.scope_note: The licensor says it claims no rights in model outputs or model derivatives based on the model. This is not a general grant concerning third-party material.
clauses.condition_explanation: Records the licensor's statement of non-claim, not a licensee duty.

clauses.scope_note: Section II.1 prohibits use of all or part of the model or its derivatives for military or illegal purposes.
clauses.condition_explanation: military_purpose means the purpose is military; illegal_purpose means it is unlawful. The paragraph separately names other activities, represented in separate clauses.

obligation_items.content: Do not use all or part of the model or a model derivative for a military or illegal purpose.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the purpose is military or illegal.

clauses.scope_note: Section II.1 prohibition on copying all or part of the model or its derivatives for military or illegal purposes.
clauses.condition_explanation: military_purpose and illegal_purpose have their ordinary factual meanings.

obligation_items.content: Do not copy all or part of the model or a model derivative for a military or illegal purpose.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the purpose is military or illegal.

clauses.scope_note: Section II.1 prohibition on modifying all or part of the model or its derivatives for military or illegal purposes.
clauses.condition_explanation: military_purpose and illegal_purpose have their ordinary factual meanings.

obligation_items.content: Do not modify all or part of the model or a model derivative for a military or illegal purpose.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the purpose is military or illegal.

clauses.scope_note: Section II.1 prohibition on publishing or distributing all or part of the model or its derivatives for military or illegal purposes.
clauses.condition_explanation: Distribution includes the defined sharing or hosted-service provision of models or derivatives; military_purpose and illegal_purpose have their ordinary factual meanings.

obligation_items.content: Do not publish or distribute all or part of the model or a model derivative for a military or illegal purpose.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the purpose is military or illegal.

clauses.scope_note: Section II.1 prohibits creating model derivatives for military or illegal purposes. The definition includes modifications, works based on the model, and specified transferred or trained models.
clauses.condition_explanation: military_purpose and illegal_purpose have their ordinary factual meanings.

obligation_items.content: Do not create a derivative of the model for a military or illegal purpose.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the purpose is military or illegal.

clauses.scope_note: Section II.2 requires prior registration and written licensor authorization for commercial use of the model or its derivatives. The annex application process is not itself authorization.
clauses.condition_explanation: commercial_use_of_model_or_derivative follows the defined Commercial Use scope; no_prior_written_authorization means no written authorization was obtained in advance.

obligation_items.content: Do not commercially use the model or its derivatives without prior registration and written authorization.
obligation_items.trigger: Before and during commercial use unless prior registration and written authorization have been completed.

clauses.scope_note: Section II.3 applies to use of the model, including use involving outputs or derivatives, and prohibits legal violations or infringement of third-party rights.
clauses.condition_explanation: complies_with_applicable_laws_and_regulations includes laws of any country, particularly PRC law. does_not_infringe_third_party_legal_rights includes personality, intellectual-property, and property rights.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the model in a manner that violates applicable law or infringes third-party legal rights.

clauses.scope_note: Section II.3 applies to modification of the model, including modifications involving outputs or model derivatives.
clauses.condition_explanation: complies_with_applicable_laws_and_regulations includes laws of any country, particularly PRC law. does_not_infringe_third_party_legal_rights includes personality, intellectual-property, and property rights.

obligation_items.content: Do not modify the model in a manner that violates applicable law or infringes third-party legal rights.

clauses.scope_note: Section II.4 requires provision of the model's source and a copy of the license to any third-party user of the model or its derivatives.
clauses.condition_explanation: third_party_uses_model_or_model_derivative means any third party uses the model or derivative. No delivery format is specified.

obligation_items.content: Provide the model's source and a copy of this license to each third-party user.
obligation_items.object: Baichuan 2 model source and license copy
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever a third party uses the model or its derivative.

clauses.scope_note: Section II.5 requires prominent disclosure of modifications when the licensee modifies the model to obtain a derivative; this clause represents that disclosure as a condition on distribution.
clauses.condition_explanation: prominently_disclose_modifications means clearly and prominently stating what was modified.

obligation_items.content: Prominently state the modifications made to the model.
obligation_items.trigger: When distributing a derivative obtained by modifying the model.

clauses.scope_note: Section II.5 requires modified derivatives not to violate license restrictions and prohibits allowing, assisting, or otherwise enabling third-party violations.
clauses.condition_explanation: The predicates describe compliance with the restrictions and the licensee's conduct toward third-party violations.

obligation_items.content: Do not allow, assist, or otherwise enable a third party to violate the license restrictions.
obligation_items.object: Modified Baichuan 2 model derivative and access or use enabled by it
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the licensee has modified the model to obtain a derivative.

clauses.scope_note: Section III.2 prohibits use of listed licensor marks, names, domains, website names, and other brand identifiers without prior written consent, including use implying the licensee is the licensor.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_of_licensor_brand_identifier includes displaying, using, registering, or implying authorization concerning the listed identifiers.

obligation_items.content: Do not use, display, register, or imply authorization to use a listed licensor brand identifier without prior written consent.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever proposing such use or registration without prior written consent.

clauses.scope_note: Section III.3 permits modification of the model to obtain a derivative within the license scope and restrictions.
clauses.condition_explanation: within_license_scope_and_complies_with_restrictions refers to the grant and Section II restrictions.

clauses.scope_note: Section III.3 permits claiming intellectual-property rights in only the derivative portion reflecting the licensee's creative labor; it does not grant rights in the upstream model.
clauses.condition_explanation: licensee_contributed_creative_labor_to_claimed_portion means that portion reflects the licensee's creative labor.

clauses.scope_note: Section IV.2 says that if the example parameters do not meet other requirements, the licensee must train independently and comply with the relevant dataset license.
clauses.condition_explanation: licensee_trains_to_meet_other_requirements means independent training is undertaken to meet requirements beyond the example parameters. The dataset license is unidentified.

obligation_items.content: Comply with the license terms governing the dataset used for independent training.
obligation_items.object: Dataset used to train a model
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever independently training to meet other requirements.

clauses.scope_note: Section IV.6 makes the licensee an independent processor of personal information potentially contained in the model. The license itself supplies no lawful basis.
clauses.condition_explanation: Processing includes collection, storage, use, processing, transfer, provision, disclosure, or deletion. Applicable laws include the PRC Personal Information Protection Law; required authorization or consent must be obtained where applicable.

obligation_items.content: Process personal information in compliance with applicable law and ensure an independent lawful basis, including required data-subject authorization or consent.
obligation_items.object: Personal information potentially contained in the model

clauses.scope_note: Section V.1 encourages nonprofit academic institution teachers and students to use the model for research, education, and academic purposes. Section V.2 makes pre-use email notice optional; the licensor may send updates.
clauses.condition_explanation: The notice may include institution name, use, and contact details; it is not a condition of use.

clauses.scope_note: Section VI.1 applies to Baichuan 2 derivatives offered under an open-source license in domestic or foreign open-source communities. “Baichuan Inside” is an example, not the exclusive wording.
clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger is offering the derivative under an open-source license in such a community.

obligation_items.content: Prominently identify the derivative as developed based on Baichuan 2 and include relevant Baichuan 2 brand elements.
obligation_items.object: Baichuan 2 derivative offered under an open-source license
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever offering it under an open-source license in a domestic or foreign open-source community.

clauses.scope_note: Section VI.2 applies to derivative participation in any domestic or foreign ranking event, including but not limited to rankings of performance, accuracy, algorithms, or computing power.
clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger is entry of the derivative in a ranking event; the notice belongs in the model description.

obligation_items.content: Prominently state in the model description that the derivative was developed based on Baichuan 2, with related brand elements.
obligation_items.object: Derivative entered in a ranking event and its model description
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the licensee enters the derivative in a domestic or foreign ranking event.

clauses.scope_note: The annex requires applicants to contact the licensor through the specified email and submit form information (applicant and agent, company size, industry and DAU, contacts and addresses, model type, intended use, derivative creation, minor users, software/cloud-provider and affiliate status, deployment regions and countries) and specified company-sealed business-license and identity/authorization documents. This application procedure is not commercial authorization; Section II.2 separately requires prior written authorization.
clauses.condition_explanation: The fields and symbolic selections remain as stated in the annex; no values are supplied. Natural persons may not apply.

obligation_items.content: Use the annex contact method and submit the required application information and supporting documents, including sealed copies where specified.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever seeking commercial authorization for the model or its derivatives.

obligation_items.content: Do not apply for a commercial license as a natural person.

coverage_notes: Definitions and section headings are context, not separately citable rules. No termination or cure procedure or patent license is stated; the grant is expressly revocable, nontransferable, and nonsublicensable.
The commercial application process does not itself authorize commercial use. The dataset license is unspecified. The license does not supply a lawful basis for personal-information processing.

Warranty and liability disclaimers, risk allocations, and governing-law/forum provisions are excluded as nonoperative for this activity-constraint extraction. Licensor enforcement language in Section IV.7 reserves licensor rights but does not impose a modeled licensee activity duty.
The source's statement that the licensor claims no rights in outputs or derivatives is not a general output-ownership grant. Branding duties apply only in their specified derivative scenarios.
